<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang='en'>
<head>
    <meta charset='UTF-8'>
    <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0'>
    <title>EVO</title>
    <link rel='shortcut icon' type='image/svg+xml' href='data:image/svg+xml;base64,'>

    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@100;200;300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap');

        * {
          color: white;
          margin: 0;
          padding: 0;
          box-sizing: border-box;
          font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
          letter-spacing: 1.4px;
        }

        body {
          background-color: #050130;
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 20px;
          padding: 50px 20px;
        }

        img {
          max-width: 500px;
          width: 100%;
          height: auto;
        }

        h1 {
          font-size: 28px;
          color: transparent;
          background: linear-gradient(to right, #00f6fd 0%, #2c52fd 33%, #c217fd 66%, #00f6fd 100%);
          background-size: 200% auto;
          animation: shine-animation 4s linear infinite;
          -webkit-background-clip: text;
          background-clip: text;
        }

        @keyframes shine-animation {
          from {
            background-position: 150% center;
          }
          to {
            background-position: -50% center;
          }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <img alt='EVO Logo' src='data:image/svg+xml;base64,' />

    <h1>Logged in successfully!</h1>
    <h1>You can get back to the application</h1>
</body>
</html>
